findings.text: One horizontal viewport wraps both board and controls. Both share width and 12.4dp inset; minimum outer width360.8 yields seven columns >=48dp. No independent control scroll remains.

Board uses max(168.8,playHeight-84) as height budget, min(width*6/7,budget) as actual height. The stage has explicit finite width/height. Wide overflow wraps that stage in a vertical scroll; no unbounded Expanded is introduced.

Actual finite preceding slivers determine precedingScrollExtent. The companion reservation includes its exact6+16dp vertical padding. playHeight>=252.8 guarantees positive board height and means the inner vertical fallback is not needed in this portrait path. Header and modes scroll with the outer viewport.
SizedBox.expand now receives the explicit board height. Existing row/column placement, circular min(w,h) diameter and GestureDetector column mapping are unchanged; pedestal uses actual boardHeight.

The new short-wide vertical fallback and existing companion vertical scroller are siblings with primary=null. Flutter3.44.9 may auto-inherit the same route PrimaryScrollController on Android/iOS. Set primary:false on the new inner fallback so it stays independently owned. No runtime assertion or failed gesture has been executed or claimed.

When horizontal content overflows, SingleChildScrollView hardEdge clips the full stage. Existing pedestal +/-18dp overhang, outer glow and decorative right side beyond board width can be clipped. Core cells and buttons remain within shared content and are scroll-exposable. Do not disable clipping to expose hidden offscreen inputs.
